heat_note: Without the rest rule, cut still at 70 C, 25 C room: the right-knee reading reaches 55 C at 1.22 min and 60 C at 1.43 min. The case reaches 49 C at 1.45 min and peaks at 61.41 C. The case does not reach 62 C in that 25 C run. After the cut unloads the knee the case cools, and at 90 min it is 27.68 C (sim pass only). The 32 C room with the same cut peaks the case at 62.14 C. It reaches 62 C at 1.95 min. Sim pass only. With the torque cut raised to 200 C on the typical corner, the reading reaches 200.09 C and the case peaks at 178.44 C (sim pass only). That stand-in cut then unloads the servo. The high-side corner with the same 200 C stand-in ends at a 175.64 C case, last-10-min rise 0.035 C, reading max 197.54 C (sim pass only). That is the balance this model reaches when the sheet cut is not allowed to hide it. The 55/45 guard, on the 10 min current, walks 14.2 percent of the 90 min at 25 C and 9.0 percent at 32 C (sim pass only). PR 86 reported 38.8 percent and 20.1 percent on the Kt-scaled old log. Guard case peak is 50.44 C at 25 C and 51.20 C at 32 C (sim pass only). The 90 min samples are 48.94 C and 49.87 C, and the last 10 min move those samples by 0.198 C and 1.594 C. The 32 C guard is still climbing at 90 min. Both peaks are above the cited 49 C PLA edge and under the cited 62 C PETG point. Putting the 0.30 V Castle drop back leaves the case peak at 61.41 C against 61.41 C on the wire (sim pass only). The knee number does not move with that trunk drop.
breaker_note: No limb sample in these walks is above 7.23 A. The highest limb peak is 6.408 A, on the 0.40 m/s jog, typical, left_leg (sim pass only). That peak is under the cited ILIM window, 7.23 A to 9.07 A, so the 600 nF timer does not start. A normal walk does not trip this breaker, and the 0.40 m/s jog does not trip it either. The 100 ms average is not the basis of that call. Calc only against the cited limits, on sim pass only currents.
